blocks.html: Drop a 3D model (like a Pix4D scan) onto the map so terrain and structures show in proper relief.

slides.title: Import the model file
slides.html: Open the Import Manager, browse to your .OBJ file, or a .ZIP that contains it, and import only that file. You can also drop the .ZIP into the atak/overlays folder to load it on startup.

slides.title: See it on the map
slides.html: Zoom in and the model loads onto the map. Two-finger swipe up or down to tilt the view and see it raised above the surface.

slides.title: Lock the 3D view
slides.html: Long press the North Arrow and select 3D to switch to 3D view. Tap 3D Lock to hold the tilt angle while you pan the map.
